cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Everything Is a Contest
cards.instruction: Turn every difference or disagreement into a competition you intend to win.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You called your pasta al dente, so I've taken mine out even sooner. Let's see whose has the most bite.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine's cooked. Yours is dry in the middle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A firmer centre, yes. Mine holds its shape better. Put yours beside it and we'll compare.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm putting yours back in the water. Nobody can eat it like that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then first plate ready wins. Mine's already draining in this sieve; give it one dip while you find a plate for yours.
